units.source_text: 日上三竿之时，小野回信来了。

en.t: When the sun was already high, a reply came from Ono.

units.source_text: 信纸是浓紫色的，非常朴素，照例是小少将君代笔的。

en.t: The letter paper was deep purple and very plain, and as usual it had been written for her by Lady Koshosho.

units.source_text: 信中告诉他：公主依旧不肯作复。

en.t: The letter told him that the princess still refused to send a reply.

units.source_text: 后面又写道：“抱歉得很：公主在来书上信笔乱涂。

en.t: Later it added, "I am very sorry: the princess scribbled freely over your letter.

units.source_text: 被我偷取得来，附呈请看。”

en.t: I secretly got hold of it, and enclose it for you to see."

units.source_text: 果然有从去信上撕下的片纸塞在这复信中。

en.t: Sure enough, a scrap torn from his earlier letter had been tucked into this reply.

units.source_text: 夕雾推想公主已经看了他的去信，只此一点，也就不胜欣慰，真乃太可怜了！

en.t: Yugiri guessed that the princess had already seen his letter, and that alone filled him with boundless comfort; how pitiful he was!

units.source_text: 他把公主信笔乱涂的文字仔细拼凑起来，看出了这样的一首诗：

en.t: He carefully pieced together the words the princess had scribbled at random, and made out the following poem:
